image.subject: a polished empty desk in a museum office with a thick cream document folder lying on it, no people

storyboard.claim: Henry makes a generous offer to buy Peton and keep it as a historical site.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Henry pushes a contract across a desk toward the reader, leaning in with a polite but intense look.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Introduces the buyer behind the tension.
storyboard.addedInformation: The buyer is a museum curator making a large offer.

image.subject: an old wooden kitchen table covered in unpaid bills and unopened envelopes, a single lamp lit in a dim farmhouse kitchen

storyboard.claim: The offer is a financial lifeline for a family that is broke.
storyboard.concreteVisual: A table buried under bills, lamp light, nobody at it.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: The offer is good on paper; now the costs.
storyboard.addedInformation: The family is financially desperate.

image.subject: orange survey stakes and string lines marking a grid across a dead-grass lawn in front of a seventeenth-century timber house, overcast sky

storyboard.claim: The tension comes from the excavation the museum would start.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Survey stakes and string laid across the lawn, marking where digging would happen.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Moves from the money to the threat.
storyboard.addedInformation: Digging would start on the estate grounds.

image.subject: a yellow excavator with its bucket raised, parked on the lawn beside an old timber house in daylight

storyboard.claim: If the museum buys the estate, heavy machinery will come in.
storyboard.concreteVisual: A yellow excavator parked at the edge of the old house.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Turns the survey stakes into an actual machine.
storyboard.addedInformation: Heavy machinery is part of the purchase plan.

image.subject: a freshly graded gravel field being laid as a parking lot, with a timber house standing at its far edge

storyboard.claim: The museum would dig to build parking lots and visitor exhibits.
storyboard.concreteVisual: A raw field turned into a parking lot, the old house in the distance.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Says what the machines would be for.
storyboard.addedInformation: The land would become a modern visitor site.

image.subject: a patch of raw dark earth in an overgrown yard, with an old weathered grave marker half sunk in the soil under a grey sky

storyboard.claim: Digging would bring up the family's buried dead from three centuries.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Dark disturbed soil and an old grave marker in the yard.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Explains what the digging would reveal.
storyboard.addedInformation: The family's dead are buried in the grounds.

image.subject: a heavy chestnut front door of an old timber house, bolted and chained shut, with a dim light behind a narrow window beside it

storyboard.claim: The estate is under siege, so the people inside take drastic measures.
storyboard.concreteVisual: A bolted chestnut door and a dim window, the house shut against outsiders.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Turns the threat into a state of siege.
storyboard.addedInformation: The inhabitants are desperate and shut inside.

image.subject: a seventeenth-century timber house with a heavy chestnut front door, seen from a gravel drive, and a woman in her thirties, slim build, shoulder-length dark hair, plain modern clothes, tired expression, standing on the step holding a suitcase

storyboard.claim: To understand Peton, follow Julia on her first day in the house.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Julia arrives at the chestnut door of the timber house with a suitcase.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Moves from the siege to the person entering it.
storyboard.addedInformation: Julia has just arrived at the estate.

image.subject: a frail elderly man in a worn work coat, bent with effort, holding open a heavy chestnut door while a woman in plain modern clothes steps into a dim entrance hall

storyboard.claim: Mick, a frail old groundskeeper, opens the door for Julia with great effort.
storyboard.concreteVisual: An old man straining to hold the heavy door open for Julia.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Julia is now at the door, so the scene steps inside.
storyboard.addedInformation: Mick is the frail elderly groundskeeper.

storyboard.claim: Mick is very old.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Text card only.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: A quick aside about the groundskeeper.
storyboard.addedInformation: Mick is frail and very old.

image.subject: a dim second-floor hallway of a timber house, low ceiling, one old lamp, a woman in her thirties, slim build, shoulder-length dark hair, plain modern clothes, tired expression, stopped dead mid-step

storyboard.claim: The air is stale and the hallway is dim; Julia stops dead.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Julia freezes in a dim upstairs hallway.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Julia is inside and now stops in the hall.
storyboard.addedInformation: The upstairs hall is dim and stale.

image.subject: a steep wooden staircase rising into darkness toward an attic hatch, seen from the hallway, with a woman in her thirties, slim build, shoulder-length dark hair, plain modern clothes, tired expression, staring up from its foot

storyboard.claim: Julia stares at the wooden staircase to the attic and sees that it is wrong.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Julia at the foot of a steep staircase looking up into the attic dark.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Julia's stop becomes a specific object: the staircase.
storyboard.addedInformation: The staircase leads up to the attic.

image.subject: a close-up of a dark wooden staircase where each tread is a different height, the steps zigzagging left and right, shot from a low angle

storyboard.claim: Each side of the stairs alternates in height.
storyboard.concreteVisual: A close-up of uneven stair treads alternating left and right.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Shows the wrongness Julia sees.
storyboard.addedInformation: The treads alternate in height side to side.

image.subject: a woman's feet in plain shoes, one on a low wooden step and the other on a higher separate block on the opposite side of a dark timber staircase

storyboard.claim: The left foot lands on one step and the right foot must land on a higher block.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Two feet stepping on alternating heights of a staircase.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Shows how the uneven steps are walked.
storyboard.addedInformation: Walking the stairs means alternating up and down.

image.subject: a woman in her thirties, slim build, shoulder-length dark hair, plain modern clothes, tired expression, gripping a wooden newel post at the foot of a steep staircase, head tilted, looking unsteady

storyboard.claim: The stairs are dizzying and throw off balance at the bottom.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Julia steadying herself against the post at the stair foot.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Moves from the stair pattern to its effect on Julia.
storyboard.addedInformation: Julia feels dizzy standing at the bottom.

image.subject: a faded old photograph of a little girl with dark hair holding the hand of an older grey-haired woman in a dim hallway, the edges softened

storyboard.claim: Julia remembers holding her grandmother Letty's hand as a little girl.
storyboard.concreteVisual: A faded print of a girl holding an older woman's hand.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Julia's dizziness pulls up a childhood memory.
storyboard.addedInformation: The grandmother is named Letty.

image.subject: an older grey-haired woman in a dark dress, half her face in shadow, smiling a thin unsettling mischievous smile at the foot of a dark staircase

storyboard.claim: Letty smiles a deeply unsettling, mischievous smile.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Letty's face in half shadow, smiling thinly.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: The memory now shows Letty.
storyboard.addedInformation: Letty's smile is unsettling.

storyboard.claim: Letty says the stairs are witches' stairs, a family legend.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Text card only.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: The smile becomes the legend she tells.
storyboard.addedInformation: The stairs are called witches' stairs in the family lore.

image.subject: a dark timber staircase with alternating treads, a row of iron nails studding the bottom step in a deliberate pattern, seen from the landing

storyboard.claim: The treads were built to trip up the supernatural, which cannot climb irregular stairs.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Irregular treads and a row of nails on the bottom step.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Adds the legend's purpose to the stairs.
storyboard.addedInformation: The stairs were meant as a supernatural trap.

image.subject: a woman in her thirties, slim build, shoulder-length dark hair, plain modern clothes, tired expression, turning her head sharply over one shoulder toward a dark staircase, a visible shiver in her posture

storyboard.claim: The image makes the hair on Julia's neck stand straight up.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Julia turns sharply toward the stairs, tense.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: The legend hits Julia physically.
storyboard.addedInformation: Julia is spooked by the legend.

image.subject: a seventeenth-century timber house at night with its shutters barred and an iron bear door knocker on the heavy chestnut door

storyboard.claim: The house is framed from page one as an active battleground against the supernatural.
storyboard.concreteVisual: The timber house at night, barred shutters, iron bear knocker on the door.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Widens the legend from the stairs to the whole house.
storyboard.addedInformation: The house is a shield against the supernatural.

image.subject: a row of restored colonial houses on a quiet village street, steep roofs and small-paned windows, a small historic sign on a post

storyboard.claim: Architectural quirks we romanticize are often physical traces of a society's paranoia.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Restored colonial houses on a quiet village street.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Moves from one house to the wider idea of old buildings.
storyboard.addedInformation: Old architecture can hide fear.

image.subject: visitors on a weekend tour of a preserved colonial house, a couple in casual clothes admiring a sharp-angled timber gable and a low leaded window

storyboard.claim: A preserved colonial home on a tour with its strange sharp angles.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Tourists looking up at a sharp-angled timber gable.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Brings the reader into the visitor's view.
storyboard.addedInformation: The tour is a weekend activity.

image.subject: a low timber ceiling with a heavy iron-barred window letting in grey light, a plain empty colonial room with old wooden floorboards

storyboard.claim: The deliberately low ceilings and heavy iron windows look quaint to us.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Low beams and an iron-barred window in an empty room.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: The tour room shows the quaint details.
storyboard.addedInformation: Low ceilings and iron windows were deliberate.

storyboard.claim: The architecture is fossilized fear.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Text card only.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: The quaint details become a verdict.
storyboard.addedInformation: Old buildings preserve the fear that built them.

image.subject: a staircase of pale oak and pine treads leading up into an attic, with a carved protective symbol cut into the wall above the door

storyboard.claim: The family turned the staircase into a magical ward against the devil in the attic.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Pale oak stairs rising to the attic, a carved symbol above the door.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: The fear becomes a family myth about the stairs.
storyboard.addedInformation: The stairs are a spell to keep the devil in the attic.

image.subject: a man in his forties, neat build, short hair, tweed jacket, polite but intense, leaning back in a diner booth and shrugging

storyboard.claim: Henry, the museum curator, bursts the supernatural bubble in a mundane way.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Henry shrugs back in a diner booth.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Moves from the myth to the man who debunks it.
storyboard.addedInformation: Henry is a museum curator.

image.subject: a retro diner booth with a black and white checkered floor, a plate of cheeseburgers and fries on the table, a man in his forties with a tweed jacket and a woman in her thirties with shoulder-length dark hair and plain modern clothes sitting across from each other

storyboard.claim: Henry takes Julia to a classic retro diner in town.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Henry and Julia in a diner booth with cheeseburgers and fries.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Sets the place for the debunking.
storyboard.addedInformation: They eat greasy cheeseburgers and fries in the diner.

image.subject: a man in his forties, neat build, short hair, tweed jacket, polite but intense, laughing softly over a tall milkshake glass in a diner booth, a woman in plain modern clothes leaning in with a serious look

storyboard.claim: Julia brings up the witch's stairs and Henry chuckles into his milkshake.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Henry chuckling over a milkshake while Julia leans in seriously.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: The same booth, now the legend is raised.
storyboard.addedInformation: Henry finds the legend amusing.

storyboard.claim: Henry declares the witches' stairs a complete myth.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Text card only.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: The laugh becomes a verdict.
storyboard.addedInformation: Henry rejects the supernatural explanation outright.

image.subject: a sepia architectural drawing of a narrow timber staircase fitted into a cramped hallway, with measurement lines and notes, laid out on a museum table

storyboard.claim: Alternating treads were a practical design that saved horizontal space in narrow hallways.
storyboard.concreteVisual: A sepia plan of a narrow staircase in a cramped hallway.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Henry's myth-busting becomes a drawing.
storyboard.addedInformation: The design saved room where a standard staircase would not fit.

left.label: WITCHES' WARD
left.subject: a dark attic doorway at the top of a staircase, a carved protective symbol above it, a single candle in the dark

right.label: SPACE SAVER
right.subject: a plain sepia drawing of a narrow timber staircase on a museum table

storyboard.claim: Henry replaces the supernatural lore with cold, pragmatic architectural utility.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Left: a candlelit attic door with a ward. Right: a plain staircase drawing.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: The drawing turns into a contrast.
storyboard.addedInformation: The supernatural explanation is replaced by practical design.

storyboard.claim: The speaker says they need to unpack the scene because it affected them.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Banter, no picture.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Pauses after Henry's explanation.
storyboard.addedInformation: The speaker reacted strongly to the scene.

image.subject: a dim timber hall in Peton, a single candle on a side table, the ornate attic door shut, cold light on the bare floorboards

storyboard.claim: Explaining the stairs as a space-saver felt like it ruined the house's horror.
storyboard.concreteVisual: An empty dim hall with a shut attic door and one candle.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: The speaker's reaction becomes the setting.
storyboard.addedInformation: The speaker felt the horror was lost.

image.subject: an antique wooden staircase displayed in a museum gallery with a small plaque, lit by a clean white spotlight, no visitors

storyboard.claim: The mystical idea that the house fights invisible demons is reduced to a mundane 17th-century design.
storyboard.concreteVisual: An antique staircase in a museum gallery under a white spotlight.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: The mundane idea gets a museum display.
storyboard.addedInformation: The demon fight is reduced to an ordinary design.

storyboard.claim: The 17th-century staircase is compared to IKEA.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Text card only.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: A joke after the museum display.
storyboard.addedInformation: The mundane design is compared to flat-pack furniture.

image.subject: a dim empty stairwell in a seventeenth-century timber house, the uneven stairs stretching up into darkness, a faint shadow falling across the steps

storyboard.claim: The pragmatic truth makes the house infinitely scarier if followed to its conclusion.
storyboard.concreteVisual: An empty uneven stairwell fading into darkness.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: The argument turns back to horror.
storyboard.addedInformation: The practical stairs make the threat human rather than spectral.
